In football (soccer), the length of a professional field can vary within certain dimensions specified by the governing bodies like FIFA. According to FIFA's Laws of the Game, the pitch (field) dimensions for 11-a-side football should be:

- Length: between 100m (110 yards) and 110m (120 yards)
- Width: between 64m (70 yards) and 100m

In professional football (soccer) fields, the dimensions for the pitch are defined by the Laws of the Game maintained by FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association). For 11-a-side football:

- The length of the pitch should be between 100-110 meters (110-120 yards).
- The width of the pitch should be between 64-75 meters (70-82 yards).
